inputs.en: Full legal name, jurisdiction and any company number.
inputs.zh-TW: 完整公司名稱、登記地區與已知公司編號。

text.en: Write one checkable question and record the clues you already have.
text.zh-TW: 寫下一個可以核對的問題，記錄目前已有線索。

text.en: Use the registry for the registration jurisdiction; compare number, name, status and filing date.
text.zh-TW: 選擇登記地區的登記庫，比較編號、名稱、狀態與申報日期。

text.en: Compare the official website or original filings against the registry identifier.
text.zh-TW: 將官網或原始申報資料的識別編號與登記記錄核對。

text.en: Link the evidence supporting your answer. Separate observations, hypotheses and unresolved questions.
text.zh-TW: 連結支持答案的證據，分開寫觀察、推測與尚未解決的問題。

no_result.en: Try former names, spelling variants or the company number. A registry in another jurisdiction may not cover it.
no_result.zh-TW: 改用舊名、其他拼寫或公司編號；不同地區登記庫可能不涵蓋。

evidence.en: Registry record R-104 lists Example Studio Ltd in jurisdiction A, active as of the recorded date.
evidence.zh-TW: 登記記錄 R-104 列出 A 地區的示例工作室，記錄日期顯示有效。

evidence.en: A website names Example Studio but does not provide a matching registration number.
evidence.zh-TW: 某網站自稱示例工作室，但沒有提供可匹配的登記編號。

choices.en: The website is trustworthy.
choices.zh-TW: 網站值得信任。

choices.en: Record R-104 confirms the registered entity, but its connection to this website remains uncertain.
choices.zh-TW: R-104 能確認登記主體，但它與這個網站的關係尚未確定。

feedback.en: Next, seek a matching legal identifier on original terms or filings. Keep website affiliation and trust separate.
feedback.zh-TW: 下一步在原始條款或申報資料中找相同法律識別碼，分開處理網站歸屬與可信度。

title.en: Does this public profile match the person?
title.zh-TW: 這個公開檔案是否對應同一個人？

inputs.en: Public name plus employer, profession or relevant time period.
inputs.zh-TW: 公開姓名，加上機構、職業或相關時間。

text.en: Write one checkable question and record the clues you already have.
text.zh-TW: 寫下一個可以核對的問題，記錄目前已有線索。

text.en: Find a candidate public professional profile; record its URL and stated employer.
text.zh-TW: 尋找候選公開職業檔案，記下網址與其聲稱的機構。

text.en: Compare an original institutional page and dates; explain any employer mismatch.
text.zh-TW: 比較原始機構頁面與日期，釐清單位不同的原因。

text.en: Link the evidence supporting your answer. Separate observations, hypotheses and unresolved questions.
text.zh-TW: 連結支持答案的證據，分開寫觀察、推測與尚未解決的問題。

no_result.en: Try alternate spelling, name order or an institutional staff page; do not infer identity from a name alone.
no_result.zh-TW: 嘗試不同拼寫、姓名順序或機構成員頁；不要只憑姓名確認身份。

evidence.en: An institutional page lists Example Researcher at Institute A in 2020.
evidence.zh-TW: 機構頁面在 2020 年列出示例研究者任職 A 機構。

evidence.en: A second institutional announcement identifies the same researcher moving from A to B in 2022.
evidence.zh-TW: 另一份機構公告明確說明該研究者於 2022 年從 A 轉到 B。

choices.en: The original announcement supports a career change; record its source and dates.
choices.zh-TW: 原始公告支持職涯變動；應記錄來源與日期。

choices.en: Different employers always prove different people.
choices.zh-TW: 單位不同一定代表不同的人。

feedback.en: This is stronger than a shared name because the announcement explicitly connects the institutions. Do not infer unrelated private details.
feedback.zh-TW: 證據比同名更充分，因公告明確連結兩個機構；不要推導無關的私人資料。

title.en: Was this image used before this event?
title.zh-TW: 這張圖片是否在事件之前出現過？

inputs.en: Image, claimed event and claimed date.
inputs.zh-TW: 圖片、聲稱的事件與日期。

text.en: Write one checkable question and record the clues you already have.
text.zh-TW: 寫下一個可以核對的問題，記錄目前已有線索。

text.en: Search for matching copies; inspect the pages containing them, not just thumbnails.
text.zh-TW: 找相同副本並打開來源頁，不只看縮圖。

text.en: Compare older copies with their publication context and independent event evidence.
text.zh-TW: 比較較早副本的發布背景與獨立事件資料。

text.en: Link the evidence supporting your answer. Separate observations, hypotheses and unresolved questions.
text.zh-TW: 連結支持答案的證據，分開寫觀察、推測與尚未解決的問題。

no_result.en: Try another engine or a distinctive crop. No match does not establish originality.
no_result.zh-TW: 換搜尋來源或以明顯局部重試；無匹配不能證明原創。

title.en: Fictional: an old image with a new caption

evidence.en: A dated original report shows the same scene in 2019.
evidence.zh-TW: 有日期的原始報導在 2019 年展示相同場景。

evidence.en: A 2025 post claims the image was captured at a new event.
evidence.zh-TW: 2025 年貼文聲稱圖片拍攝於一個新事件。

choices.en: The old report identifies the photographer and proves the new event never happened.
choices.zh-TW: 舊報導證明攝影者身份，也證明新事件沒有發生。

choices.en: The earlier matching report contradicts the claimed capture date, but does not identify the creator or disprove the event.
choices.zh-TW: 較早的匹配報導與聲稱拍攝日期矛盾，但不能確認作者或否定事件。

feedback.en: Trace the original report and compare the actual image. The supported conclusion concerns this image’s context, not every claim about the event.
feedback.zh-TW: 追溯原報導並核對圖片；目前能支持的是這張圖片的背景判斷，不是對事件所有說法的判斷。

title.en: Where did this claim come from?
title.zh-TW: 這個說法最初來自哪裡？

inputs.en: Exact claim, named source and event date.
inputs.zh-TW: 原句、聲稱的來源與事件日期。

text.en: Write one checkable question and record the clues you already have.
text.zh-TW: 寫下一個可以核對的問題，記錄目前已有線索。

text.en: Look for a relevant published check, then read its cited evidence.
text.zh-TW: 找相關查核，並閱讀其中引用的證據。

text.en: Trace original statements or documents; copied stories count as one source family.
text.zh-TW: 追溯原始聲明或文件；轉載同一材料只算一組來源。

text.en: Link the evidence supporting your answer. Separate observations, hypotheses and unresolved questions.
text.zh-TW: 連結支持答案的證據，分開寫觀察、推測與尚未解決的問題。

no_result.en: Search a distinctive phrase and language variants. No published check is not a truth verdict.
no_result.zh-TW: 搜尋有辨識度的原句與其他語言；沒有查核不代表說法真實。

title.en: Fictional: three copies of one source
title.zh-TW: 虛構：一份材料的三個轉載

evidence.en: Three pages repeat the same original statement, without additional evidence.
evidence.zh-TW: 三個頁面重複同一份原始聲明，沒有額外證據。

choices.en: Count them as three independent sources.
choices.zh-TW: 算成三個獨立來源。

choices.en: Trace the original and seek independent corroboration.
choices.zh-TW: 追溯原件，再找獨立佐證。

feedback.en: Repeats help trace dissemination, but do not add independent evidence. Record the source relationship.
feedback.zh-TW: 轉載可以幫助追溯傳播，但沒有增加獨立證據；記錄來源之間的關係。

title.en: Has this website changed its claims?
title.zh-TW: 這個網站是否改過說法？

inputs.en: Exact URL and approximate time range.
inputs.zh-TW: 完整網址與大致時間範圍。

text.en: Write one checkable question and record the clues you already have.
text.zh-TW: 寫下一個可以核對的問題，記錄目前已有線索。

text.en: Compare captured versions and note capture timestamps separately from event dates.
text.zh-TW: 比較保存版本，將保存時間與事件日期分開記錄。

text.en: Compare current content and independent records; snapshots do not establish ownership.
text.zh-TW: 比較目前內容與獨立記錄；保存頁面不能直接證明擁有者。

text.en: Link the evidence supporting your answer. Separate observations, hypotheses and unresolved questions.
text.zh-TW: 連結支持答案的證據，分開寫觀察、推測與尚未解決的問題。

no_result.en: Try the canonical URL, http/https variants or referenced original documents. Archive gaps are normal.
no_result.zh-TW: 嘗試正式網址、http/https 版本或所引用原件；存檔可能有缺口。

title.en: Fictional: what can this evidence establish?
title.zh-TW: 虛構：這筆證據能支持什麼？

evidence.en: One archive capture contains a statement; there are no captures for the following year.
evidence.zh-TW: 一個存檔版本含某項聲明，隔年沒有保存版本。

choices.en: The statement appears in this captured version. The archive gap cannot establish what the website said the following year.
choices.zh-TW: 這項聲明出現在該保存版本；存檔缺口不能證明網站隔年說了什麼。

choices.en: One matching result proves the entire claim.
choices.zh-TW: 一筆匹配結果能證明整個說法。

feedback.en: Seek another dated capture or original document before claiming when a change occurred.
feedback.zh-TW: 先找其他有日期的保存版本或原始文件，才能判斷何時發生變更。

title.en: How can I check a merchant’s background?
title.zh-TW: 如何核實商家的公開背景？

inputs.en: Legal entity, claimed address and website; distinguish a brand from its operator.
inputs.zh-TW: 法律主體、聲稱地址與網站；分清品牌與經營主體。

text.en: Write one checkable question and record the clues you already have.
text.zh-TW: 寫下一個可以核對的問題，記錄目前已有線索。

text.en: Identify the operator, then choose the appropriate official registry.
text.zh-TW: 先確認經營主體，再選擇適用的官方登記庫。

text.en: Compare dated records and independent reports. One review or registration is not a reliability verdict.
text.zh-TW: 比較有日期的記錄與獨立報導；一則評論或登記不能判定可信度。

text.en: Link the evidence supporting your answer. Separate observations, hypotheses and unresolved questions.
text.zh-TW: 連結支持答案的證據，分開寫觀察、推測與尚未解決的問題。

no_result.en: Look for the legal name in terms, receipts or public contact pages; a brand may differ from a registered name.
no_result.zh-TW: 從條款、收據或公開聯絡頁找法律名稱；品牌不一定是登記名稱。

title.en: Fictional: what can this evidence establish?
title.zh-TW: 虛構：這筆證據能支持什麼？

evidence.en: A company record matches the merchant’s number; there is no evidence about service quality.
evidence.zh-TW: 公司記錄與商家編號一致，但沒有服務品質的證據。

choices.en: The number connects the merchant to a registered entity. Service quality remains unverified.
choices.zh-TW: 編號能將商家與登記主體連結，服務品質仍未核實。

choices.en: One matching result proves the entire claim.
choices.zh-TW: 一筆匹配結果能證明整個說法。

feedback.en: Check independent dated reports about the specific service question; do not turn registration into a trust score.
feedback.zh-TW: 找與具體服務問題相關的獨立、有日期資料；不要把登記轉成信任評分。

title.en: Can I trace this public document?
title.zh-TW: 能否追溯這份公開文件？

inputs.en: Title, issuing organisation, publication date and original file if available.
inputs.zh-TW: 標題、發布機構、日期，以及可取得的原始檔案。

text.en: Write one checkable question and record the clues you already have.
text.zh-TW: 寫下一個可以核對的問題，記錄目前已有線索。

text.en: Find the issuer’s original publication or an applicable official repository.
text.zh-TW: 找發布機構的原始頁面或適用的官方資料庫。

text.en: Compare revisions, issuing body and passages. Metadata alone cannot establish authenticity.
text.zh-TW: 比較修訂版本、發布機構及原文；中繼資料不能單獨證明真偽。

text.en: Link the evidence supporting your answer. Separate observations, hypotheses and unresolved questions.
text.zh-TW: 連結支持答案的證據，分開寫觀察、推測與尚未解決的問題。

no_result.en: Try an exact title fragment, another language or filetype:pdf; check geographic coverage.
no_result.zh-TW: 嘗試標題片段、其他語言或 filetype:pdf，並注意地區範圍。

title.en: Fictional: what can this evidence establish?
title.zh-TW: 虛構：這筆證據能支持什麼？

evidence.en: The issuer publishes version 2; a shared file is labelled version 1.
evidence.zh-TW: 發布機構提供第二版，流傳檔案標示第一版。

choices.en: Version 2 is published by the issuer. Differences from the shared version 1 still need comparison.
choices.zh-TW: 發布機構已提供第二版；它與流傳第一版的差異仍需比較。

choices.en: One matching result proves the entire claim.
choices.zh-TW: 一筆匹配結果能證明整個說法。

feedback.en: Read both versions and revision notes; an older version is not automatically fabricated.
feedback.zh-TW: 閱讀兩個版本與修訂說明；較舊版本不一定是偽造。

title.zh-TW: 有什麼研究支持這個說法？

inputs.en: Research question, topic terms and approximate period.
inputs.zh-TW: 研究問題、主題詞與大致期間。

text.en: Write one checkable question and record the clues you already have.
text.zh-TW: 寫下一個可以核對的問題，記錄目前已有線索。

text.en: Find relevant publications; inspect the original abstract, methods and limitations.
text.zh-TW: 找相關出版文獻，閱讀原始摘要、方法與限制。

text.en: Compare independent studies and populations; citation counts are not proof of a claim.
text.zh-TW: 比較獨立研究及研究對象；引用數不能證明說法。

text.en: Link the evidence supporting your answer. Separate observations, hypotheses and unresolved questions.
text.zh-TW: 連結支持答案的證據，分開寫觀察、推測與尚未解決的問題。

no_result.en: Use field terminology, referenced works or other versions; distinguish paywalls from no records.
no_result.zh-TW: 改用領域用語、參考文獻或其他版本；付費牆不等於不存在。

title.en: Fictional: what can this evidence establish?
title.zh-TW: 虛構：這筆證據能支持什麼？

evidence.en: A study reports results for one small sample and states its limitations.
evidence.zh-TW: 研究針對一個小樣本報告結果，並列出限制。

choices.en: The reported findings apply to the study’s sample and methods. Wider applicability is unresolved.
choices.zh-TW: 報告結果適用於研究的樣本與方法，更廣泛的適用性尚未確定。

choices.en: One matching result proves the entire claim.
choices.zh-TW: 一筆匹配結果能證明整個說法。

feedback.en: Compare populations, methods and independent studies, including conflicting results.
feedback.zh-TW: 比較研究對象、方法與獨立研究，也記錄相反結果。

title.en: Does this video fit the claimed event?
title.zh-TW: 這段影片是否符合聲稱的事件？

inputs.en: Public video URL or file, claimed place and date.
inputs.zh-TW: 公開影片網址或檔案、聲稱地點與日期。

text.en: Write one checkable question and record the clues you already have.
text.zh-TW: 寫下一個可以核對的問題，記錄目前已有線索。

text.en: Extract useful frames using supported features and inspect the original upload context.
text.zh-TW: 按工具支援功能擷取關鍵畫面，閱讀原始上傳背景。

text.en: Compare earlier uploads, visible landmarks and independent event records.
text.zh-TW: 比較較早上傳、可見地標與獨立事件記錄。

text.en: Link the evidence supporting your answer. Separate observations, hypotheses and unresolved questions.
text.zh-TW: 連結支持答案的證據，分開寫觀察、推測與尚未解決的問題。

no_result.en: Reverse-search distinct frames or search captions. A failed automated check is not proof.
no_result.zh-TW: 以明顯畫面反向搜尋或搜尋字幕；自動分析失敗不能證明真偽。

title.en: Fictional: what can this evidence establish?
title.zh-TW: 虛構：這筆證據能支持什麼？

evidence.en: A matching frame exists, but its source page gives no capture date.
evidence.zh-TW: 找到相同畫面，但來源頁沒有拍攝日期。

choices.en: A matching frame is a source lead. The claimed capture date has not been established.
choices.zh-TW: 相同畫面是來源線索，聲稱的拍攝日期尚未確認。

choices.en: One matching result proves the entire claim.
choices.zh-TW: 一筆匹配結果能證明整個說法。

feedback.en: Find dated original uploads and event evidence; an upload date and a capture date are different.
feedback.zh-TW: 尋找有日期的原始上傳與事件證據；上傳日期不等於拍攝日期。

title.en: Can I verify the place shown in a photo?
title.zh-TW: 能否核實照片中的地點？

inputs.en: Visible landmarks, roads and terrain; approximate area if known.
inputs.zh-TW: 可見地標、道路與地形；已知時補充大致區域。

text.en: Write one checkable question and record the clues you already have.
text.zh-TW: 寫下一個可以核對的問題，記錄目前已有線索。

text.en: Compare several visible features with map or street-level imagery.
text.zh-TW: 將多個可見特徵與地圖或街景影像比較。

text.en: Check spatial relationships and imagery dates, not just one similar building.
text.zh-TW: 核對空間關係與影像日期，不只看一棟相似建築。

text.en: Link the evidence supporting your answer. Separate observations, hypotheses and unresolved questions.
text.zh-TW: 連結支持答案的證據，分開寫觀察、推測與尚未解決的問題。

no_result.en: Broaden the area or try older imagery. Missing map coverage does not disprove a location.
no_result.zh-TW: 擴大區域或找較舊影像；缺少涵蓋不能否定地點。

title.en: Fictional: what can this evidence establish?
title.zh-TW: 虛構：這筆證據能支持什麼？

evidence.en: One building resembles the photo, but the road layout differs.
evidence.zh-TW: 一棟建築與照片相似，但道路配置不同。

choices.en: The building is a candidate clue, but the conflicting roads do not support a confirmed location.
choices.zh-TW: 建築是候選線索，但道路衝突不足以支持已確認地點。

choices.en: One matching result proves the entire claim.
choices.zh-TW: 一筆匹配結果能證明整個說法。

feedback.en: Check imagery dates and several spatial relationships before deciding whether to discard or retain the candidate.
feedback.zh-TW: 先核對影像日期與多個空間關係，再決定是否保留候選地點。
